title: Fidelity Sentinel: partial-response recovery & function-call contract suite
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Goal: Create a regression and contract test suite that validates the runtime's behavior under partial/early streaming termination, interleaved function/tool calls, and structured-output reassembly across API compatibility layers. This ticket bundles test definitions, CI integration, and a lightweight local harness for devs to reproduce failures. Motivation: we continue to see flaky failures where partial JSON fragments, interrupted streams, or mismatched function-call envelopes cause downstream SDKs and customer code to see malformed payloads or blocking behavior. This suite focuses on reproducible golden seeds, automatic assertion of idempotent reassembly, and explicit fallbacks when a full structured payload cannot be reconstructed.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CI job 'fidelity-sentinel' runs on PRs and nightly and fails the PR if any contract test regresses. 2) Tests cover: (a) partial-stream cutoff and resumption with KV cache priming, (b) interleaved function-call tokens where tool metadata and return payloads arrive out-of-order, (c) structured-output fallback to NDJSON envelope when final JSON is malformed. 3) SDK adapters (Python/Node) included mocks verifying client-visible API shape stays stable. 4) Documented troubleshooting steps and links to Grafana panels for every test. 5) On first run of suite in CI, no unexpected regressions vs baseline golden seeds.
steps: Draft test matrix mapping model variants, sequence lengths, and batch sizes
Author 40+ seed prompts that exercise: truncated responses, multi-tool interleaving, and schema drift
Implement harness that can inject stream truncation and replays (local docker target)
Add assertions for: canonical JSON reassembly, function-call idempotency, KV cache warm vs cold behavior
Create CI workflow that runs fast smoke on PRs and full regression nightly
Add SDK adapter shims to replay failing traces and capture client-visible diffs
Ship baseline golden seeds into artifacts store and record hashes in test metadata
tests: smoke/partial_cutoff_resume: simulate abrupt connection close at token N and resume from cached prefix
interop/multi_tool_interleave: two simultaneous function calls where tool A returns after tool B's metadata chunks
schema/fallback_ndjson: final payload intentionally contains trailing garbage to validate NDJSON envelope recovery
fidelity/kv_warm_vs_cold: validate output equivalence when KV cache is primed vs unprimed
sdk/node_adapter_roundtrip: run Node SDK adapter against harness and assert idempotent parse
sdk/python_adapter_timeout: assert client sees explicit error code and does not block on incomplete JSON
updates: 2025-02-12 - Ticket created by Sofia Martinez: initial spec and motivation added.
2025-02-18 - Design review notes: prefer lightweight NDJSON fallback over aggressive auto-correction; PM concurs.
2025-02-24 - Implementation: local harness scaffold merged (PR #4821). Added initial 12 seed prompts and CI smoke job.
2025-02-28 - QA found a race when replaying cached KV for resumed streams; added deterministic replay ordering to harness.
2025-03-01 - Eng review with SDK team: agreed on adapter-level defensive parsing and added two adapter tests to matrix.
notes: Trade-offs considered: 1) aggressive JSON repair risks masking model regressions — decided to prefer explicit NDJSON envelope and failure signals. 2) Running full long-sequence regressions on every PR is too expensive; adopt smoke/full split. Observability: each failing seed emits an artifact with token trace, KV cache state, and a minimal reproduction script.
